events.verdict: Queta (BOS) contests the post shot attempt and the contact with Zubac's (LAC) wrist/hand after the release is marginal.
Queta (BOS) moves toward the basket and the ensuing contact with Sanders (LAC) is incidental.
Walsh (BOS) rests an arm against Harden (LAC) during his shooting motion and the contact does not affect his shot attempt.
Pritchard (BOS) engages with Bogdanovic (LAC) after the switch and the contact between the two players is marginal.
Queta (BOS0 firms up in a position and as Sanders (LAC) moves around the screen, the contact is marginal.
Queta (BOS) firms up in a screening position in Sanders' (LAC) path and does not deliver contact.
Sanders (LAC) legally contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Queta (BOS) jumps for the rebound and any ensuing contact with Zubac (LAC) is marginal.
Bogdanovic (LAC) reaches in and the ensuing contact with Brown's (BOS) arm is marginal.
Queta (BOS) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
Bogdanovic (LAC) rests a hand on Queta's (BOS) body during his shooting motion and the contact is marginal.
Harden (LAC) releases away from Walsh (BOS) as he steps back.

Walsh (BOS) moves forward into Harden (LAC) as he contests, initiating illegal leg contact as Harden returns to the floor. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul called on Walsh does not meet the criteria for a flagrant foul.
White (BOS) contests Harden (LAC)"s jump shot attempt and the marginal contact does not prevent him from following through.
Hauser (BOS) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Collins (LAC) commits a take foul on White (BOS).
Zubac (LAC) establishes a position in Walsh's (BOS) path and gives him room the avoid the contact.
Brown (BOS) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Harden (LAC) commits a take foul on Pritchard (BOS).
Hauser (BOS) rests his hand on Zubac's (LAC) back and quickly retracts it as Zubac receives the pass.
Walsh (BOS) avoids making any contact with Harden (LAC) during his jump shot attempt.
